text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down despite several months without trades, so I should monitor its overall risk without reacting to every small change.","Selling Stock A and Stock B below my average costs and Stock E above cost reminds me that past gains or losses alone should not dictate a trade; I should assess each holding’s current prospects and my exposure.","Because these savings support my retirement, I should keep decisions measured, avoid frequent trading, and preserve enough stability to meet living expenses."]}
